note: Calamaio's variables: what C-h v describes and Customize changes. A changed value is stored in state.settings; the defaults stay here.

fill-column.title: Fill Column
fill-column.description: Where auto-fill breaks a line, and what M-q fills to, in columns.

tab-width.title: Tab Width
tab-width.description: How many columns a tab character takes.

indent-tabs-mode.title: Indent Tabs Mode
indent-tabs-mode.description: Whether indenting puts tab characters in, or only spaces.

inhibit-startup-screen.title: Inhibit Startup Screen
inhibit-startup-screen.description: Whether the frame starts without the welcome screen.

cursor-type.title: Cursor Type
cursor-type.description: How point is drawn: a filled box, a thin bar or a line under the character.

show-paren-mode.title: Show Paren Mode
show-paren-mode.description: Whether the bracket that matches the one at point is highlighted.

electric-pair-mode.title: Electric Pair Mode
electric-pair-mode.description: Whether typing an opening bracket or quote also types its closing one.

global-display-line-numbers-mode.title: Global Display Line Numbers Mode
global-display-line-numbers-mode.description: Whether every buffer shows its line numbers in the margin.

tool-bar-mode.title: Tool Bar Mode
tool-bar-mode.description: Whether the frame shows its tool bar under the menu bar.

menu-bar-mode.title: Menu Bar Mode
menu-bar-mode.description: Whether the frame shows its menu bar.

custom-enabled-themes.title: Custom Enabled Themes
custom-enabled-themes.description: The theme the faces' colours come from.

kill-ring-max.title: Kill Ring Max
kill-ring-max.description: How many kills the kill ring keeps before it forgets the oldest.

search-highlight.title: Search Highlight
search-highlight.description: Whether incremental search also highlights the other matches on screen.
